title: Outward Flux of a Radial Field Through a Sphere
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the outward flux of F = <x, y, z> through the sphere of radius R = 2 centered at the origin.

steps.title: Identify Outward Unit Normal
steps.mathExpression: \mathbf{n} = \frac{\langle x, y, z \rangle}{R} = \frac{1}{2}\langle x, y, z \rangle
steps.explanation: The unit normal points radially outward.

steps.title: Evaluate F . n on Sphere
steps.explanation: The normal component is constant and equals the sphere radius 2.

steps.title: Integrate Constant Value Over Sphere
steps.explanation: Multiply 2 by total spherical surface area 16*pi.
